mapper.select: SELECT PAY_YM AS "month", DEV_ID AS "personId", PAY_AMT AS "pay", ALWNC_AMT AS "allowance", INSR_CMPNY_AMT AS "companyInsurance", INSR_SELF_AMT AS "selfInsurance", RETIRE_RSV_AMT AS "retirementReserve", INCM_TAX_AMT AS "incomeTax", WTHLD_TAX_AMT AS "withholdingTax", REAL_PAY_AMT AS "netPay", VNDR_SPLY_AMT AS "vendorSupply", EMP_TYPE_CD AS "employeeType", DRCT_CLS_CD AS "directClass", UPLD_ID::text AS "uploadId", REG_USER_ID AS "regUserId", REG_DTTM AS "regDttm", MOD_USER_ID AS "modUserId", MOD_DTTM AS "modDttm" FROM TB_HR_MON_PAY WHERE PAY_YM >= #{fromMonth} AND PAY_YM <= #{toMonth} ORDER BY PAY_YM,DEV_ID
mapper.sql: m.INPUT_YM AS "month", m.DEV_ID AS "personId", m.PROJ_ID AS "projectId", m.ASGN_ID AS "assignmentId", m.MON_MM AS "assignmentMm", m.APLY_UPRC AS "appliedUnitPrice", m.SALES_AMT AS "salesAmount", m.FIX_YN AS "fixed", a.JOB_CD AS "jobCode", a.INPUT_TYPE_CD AS "inputType", a.CTRT_DEV_ID AS "contractPersonId", a.ASGN_STAT_CD AS "status", a.INPUT_BGN_DT AS "fromDate", a.INPUT_END_DT AS "toDate"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_MON m LEFT JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN a ON a.ASGN_ID=m.ASGN_ID WHERE m.INPUT_YM >= #{fromMonth} AND m.INPUT_YM <= #{toMonth} ORDER BY m.INPUT_YM,m.DEV_ID,m.PROJ_ID,m.ASGN_ID

SELECT FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_MON m LEFT JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN a ON a.ASGN_ID=m.ASGN_ID WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_MON r WHERE r.PROJ_ID=m.PROJ_ID AND r.INPUT_YM >= #{fromMonth} AND r.INPUT_YM <= #{toMonth}) ORDER BY m.PROJ_ID,m.INPUT_YM,m.DEV_ID,m.ASGN_ID

SELECT PROJ_ID AS "projectId", PROJ_NM AS "name", CTRT_TYPE_CD AS "contractType", PROJ_STAT_CD AS "status", LOSE_DT AS "loseDate", CTRT_BGN_DT AS "fromDate", CTRT_END_DT AS "toDate", CTRT_AMT AS "contractAmount", BDGT_AMT AS "budget", TEAM_EXPS_AMT AS "teamExpense", PROJ_EXPS_AMT AS "projectExpense" FROM TB_PJ_PROJ ORDER BY PROJ_ID
SELECT PROJ_ID AS "projectId", APLY_BGN_YM AS "fromMonth", PART_ID AS "partId" FROM TB_PJ_PROJ_PART ORDER BY PROJ_ID,APLY_BGN_YM

SELECT PROJ_ID AS "projectId", DSTRB_STEP_CD AS "step", ROW_SN::text AS "sequence", DSTRB_YM AS "month", ROW_TYPE_CD AS "rowType", DEV_ID AS "personId", ITEM_NM AS "itemName", DSTRB_AMT AS "amount", UPLD_ID::text AS "uploadId" FROM TB_PJ_TK_DSTRB ORDER BY PROJ_ID,DSTRB_STEP_CD,ROW_SN,DSTRB_YM

SELECT c.COST_YM AS "month", c.DEV_ID AS "personId", c.PROJ_ID AS "projectId", c.ASGN_ID AS "assignmentId", c.ASGN_MM AS "assignmentMm", c.FREE_MM AS "freeMm", c.SALES_AMT AS "personalRevenue", c.LABOR_ALLOC_AMT AS "laborAllocated", c.TEAM_EXPS_AMT AS "teamExpense", c.PROJ_EXPS_AMT AS "projectExpense", c.DRCT_EXPS_AMT AS "directExpense", c.COST_CLS_CD AS "costClass", c.CTRT_TYPE_CD AS "contractType", c.PART_ID AS "projectSalesPartId", c.FIX_YN AS "fixed", c.REG_USER_ID AS "regUserId", c.REG_DTTM AS "regDttm", c.MOD_USER_ID AS "modUserId", c.MOD_DTTM AS "modDttm", p.PROJ_NM AS "projectName", a.JOB_CD AS "assignmentJobCode", a.INPUT_TYPE_CD AS "inputType" FROM TB_CO_MON_COST c LEFT JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.PROJ_ID=c.PROJ_ID LEFT JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN a ON a.ASGN_ID=c.ASGN_ID WHERE c.COST_YM >= #{fromMonth} AND c.COST_YM <= #{toMonth} ORDER BY c.COST_YM,c.DEV_ID,c.PROJ_ID,c.ASGN_ID
SELECT STD_CD AS "code", APLY_BGN_YM AS "fromMonth", STD_VAL AS "value" FROM TB_SY_OPER_STD WHERE APLY_BGN_YM <= #{toMonth} ORDER BY STD_CD,APLY_BGN_YM
SELECT PART_ID AS "partId", PART_NM AS "name", HQ_YN AS "headquarters", USE_YN AS "useYn" FROM TB_BS_PART ORDER BY PART_ID
SELECT CLNT_ID AS "companyId", CLNT_NM AS "name" FROM TB_BS_CLNT WHERE CLNT_TYPE_CD IN ('VNDR','BOTH') ORDER BY CLNT_NM, CLNT_ID
